hook: Did you know a day on Venus is longer than its entire year?

segments.text: Venus rotates so slowly that a single spin takes 243 Earth days.
segments.visualDirection: slow pan across a glowing, cloud-wrapped Venus

segments.text: But it orbits the Sun in just 225 days, so its day is longer than its year.
segments.visualDirection: diagram of Venus tracing its orbit around the Sun

youtube.title: Venus: A Day Longer Than Its Year
youtube.description: The strange, ultra-slow rotation of Venus, explained in 30 seconds.

tiktok.title: Venus is WILD
